snippet.title: Mo Mayhem | Windows Playtest Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Official gameplay footage from Mo Mayhem, a pixel-art platform fighter set in the Delivery Mo universe. Captured in Windows Playtest Build 423 across Guardian Academy, Rooftop Rush and After Hours Arcade.

Free Windows playtest: https://guardianrealms.itch.io/mo-mayhem

Developed by DeeZie Media Group.
Music: “Battle Theme A” by cynicmusic (CC0) — https://opengameart.org/content/battle-theme-a
